title: fix(plugin-form): a section declared `collapsed` installs its disclosure control (objectui#9780)
body:
Fixes #9780

Clause-②: no — tested against THIS diff, ⛔ not inherited from the claim. No new
exported symbol (the diff adds none: `grep -E "^\+.*\bexport\b"` over the
branch's `packages/plugin-form/src` diff matches nothing), and no new key on any
published payload — the divider pseudo-row already emitted `collapsible`,
`collapsed` and `onToggle`; only what the first and third are computed FROM
moved. The authorable accept set is unchanged: both spellings were accepted
before, and behaviour widens only.

## The ruling this implements

Maintainer ruling 2026-09-18, batch #161 item 4, **letter A** (director seat
comment on the card; maintainer 「其他同意」). Quoted verbatim:

> `object-form`: a section with `collapsed: true` is collapsible — the toggle is
installed; `collapsible: true` alone (open, toggle present) is unchanged;
`collapsible: false` with `collapsed: true` is the same contradiction and
resolves the same way (collapsed wins, toggle present), noted in the describe.

⛔ Letter **B** (refuse the combination at the declaration face) and letter **C**
(a dev-only `console.warn`) were refused and are ⛔ not re-opened here.

⚠️ **The ruling has two halves and only one is in this repo.** The second bullet
— the `sections[].collapsed` describe stating 「implies `collapsible`」 — lives in
objectstack's `packages/spec`, which this repo consumes as a published dependency
(objectui declares `collapsible` only for the disclosure/accordion family, and
there is no form-section schema or `forms.zod.ts` under `packages/types/src/zod/`
to hold the sentence). ⇒ this pull request is the **behaviour half** only; the
describe line is an upstream card the PM has recorded. The behaviour half does
not depend on it: the describe documents the behaviour, it does not gate it.

## What changed

`packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx`, grouped (default) layout. The initial
state was read off `collapsed` unconditionally while the disclosure control was
installed only for a section that also wrote `collapsible` — so `collapsed: true`
written alone, the most natural spelling of "collapsed by default", rendered a
section that starts closed, keeps its fields out of the DOM, and offers nothing
on the page able to bring them back, with no error, warning or degradation.

The divider row's `collapsible` and its `onToggle` now both derive from one
`isCollapsible`, read off the **declaration** (`section.collapsible` OR
`section.collapsed`) and ⛔ never off the live collapse state — deriving it from
the live state would install the control while closed and delete it the moment
the user opened the section, i.e. a section openable exactly once. The
`if (label)` heading gate and its three riders (the ADR-0089 predicate row, the
objectui#6236 membership claim, the untitled-bucket rule) are untouched.

## Tests

New pin `packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/collapsedImpliesCollapsible-9780.test.tsx`
— four rows, covering each case the ruling names:

1. `collapsed: true` alone — starts closed, a control IS on the page, clicking it
   hands the fields back; clicked twice, because the control must survive the
   section being opened.
2. `collapsible: true` alone — unchanged: open, control present, still closes.
3. `collapsible: false` with `collapsed: true` — collapsed wins, control present,
   opens on click.
4. Absence control — a section declaring neither member draws its heading, draws
   its fields, and carries no control at all, so the reader rows 1-3 use to find
   the toggle is one that can report none.

The rows pin the **decision**, not just the outcome: letter C leaves rows 1 and 3
without a control and fails them, and letter B would refuse the row-1 combination
outright.

`objectFormSectionMembers-8071.test.tsx` row 4 **flipped**, in the same change
that made the implication true — it had pinned the trap AS behaviour (that is how
objectui#8071 slice 11 found it), exactly as rows 6 and 7 of that same file
flipped when their own rulings landed. It keeps its job and still reads
`collapsible: true` alone as an open section, so the implication running one way
only stays pinned. That row is the one test in the package my change reds; it is
the only test outside the new file that this branch touches.

Evidence, all run on this branch's tree:

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/` → `Test Files 101 passed (101)`,
  `Tests 947 passed | 1 skipped (948)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form run type-check` (echoed
  `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) → exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/plugin-form^...' build` (dependency closure) → exit 0.
- Package lint unit (`eslint .` in `packages/plugin-form`, what CI's `pnpm lint`
  runs for this package) → exit 0; `--format json` reports **131 files** linted,
  0 errors. Narrowing to this package is sound because `eslint.config.js` enables
  no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, no `projectService`), so each
  file's verdict is computed from that file alone and this diff cannot move the
  verdict of any file it does not touch. The repo-wide run is CI's.
- Gates: `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations),
  `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:lint-coverage`,
  `check:changeset-presence`, `check:changeset-claims`,
  `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:governed-queue-guard --test` (NOT
  GOVERNED) — all exit 0.

### Reverse verification (ablation)

Run from the committed fix, mutating `ObjectForm.tsx` back to the pre-ruling
gating (`collapsible: section.collapsible` / `onToggle: section.collapsible`).
Direction predicted before the run: rows 1 and 3 of the new file plus the flipped
row 4 go red, the unchanged spellings stay green.

- The mutation reached disk, proven by anchor counts either side of the write
  (`collapsible: isCollapsible,` 1 → 0, `onToggle: isCollapsible` 1 → 0,
  `onToggle: section.collapsible` 0 → 1) and by the blob hash changing.
- Mutated run: `Tests 3 failed | 11 passed (14)`, failing with
  `expected [] to have a length of 1` on each disclosure-control assertion — the
  right reason, ⛔ not an unrelated error.
- Restored by `git checkout HEAD -- packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx` under
  a trap, proven by STATE: the restored blob hash equals the HEAD blob hash and
  `git diff HEAD` for that path is empty.

## Acceptance notes

Out of scope, noted here and reported to the PM rather than fixed in this pull
request (the dispatch fences this branch to `ObjectForm.tsx`, its pins and one
changeset):

- **The same trap exists in `DrawerForm.tsx`.** Its explicit-`sections` divider
  push reads `collapsed` for the initial state unconditionally and installs
  `onToggle` only for `collapsible`, and its collapse branch is not gated on a
  heading either — so a drawer form (`formType: 'drawer'`, reached straight
  through `ObjectForm`'s drawer map, which copies both members) still renders a
  permanently closed, unopenable section for `collapsed: true` alone. Same class
  as this card, a different site, and ⛔ not fixed here. The file's OTHER site,
  the derived-fieldGroups fallback, is already safe (it reads `collapsed` only
  when `collapsible` is declared) — which is a third resolution of the same pair,
  a fourth one now that this layout implements the ruling.
- **Observation, ⛔ not a card:** `FormSectionContainer` (published from
  `@object-ui/plugin-form`) has the same shape at the React-prop level —
  `collapsed` without `collapsible` renders no content and no control. It is a
  component prop, not authored metadata, and no layout in this repo passes it
  those props (the wizard, its only caller, passes neither).

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** — 表单分区只写 `collapsed: true`、没写 `collapsible: true` 时,
以前会渲染成一个永远打不开的区块:字段不在页面上,也没有任何可点的东西能把它们拿回来。
现在这种写法会自带展开控件,点一下就能打开、再点一下能关上。

**为什么改** — 「默认折叠」是最常见的意图,`collapsed: true` 是它最自然的拼法,
而它单独写下来恰好是坏的,运行时还不报错、不警告。裁决按 A 案:`collapsed` 蕴含
`collapsible`。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** — 风险很低:接受集一个字节都没动(两种拼法以前就都接受),
只是行为放宽了 —— 一个打不开的区块没有人能依赖它,所以没有输家。
`collapsible: true` 单写的行为完全不变(由一条独立的钉子看着)。
回滚就是把两处改回读 `section.collapsible`,三条钉子会立刻变红并指明原因。

**席位意见** — (留空,待认领席定稿)

**你要做的** — 不需要做什么。⚠️ 只有一点要知道:裁决的另一半(spec 里
`sections[].collapsed` 的 describe 加上「implies `collapsible`」那句话)在
objectstack 仓,本 PR 做不到,PM 已记为一张上游卡。另外 drawer 布局里还有同样一处陷阱,
见上面的 Acceptance notes,那需要另一张卡。
